svg.title: Smart Warehouse Planner — landing
svg.desc: Landing page: one-line promise, the six-stop flow drawn as a metro line, a fragment of the warehouse network map, and the start of the three-rules section.
svg.text: Import Locations, Inventory and Transactions. Every part is sorted by picks,
and the tool recommends moves in rounds, each with its rule and its numbers.
You decide what to apply, then print the move list.
Synthetic demo data · 2,000 locations · data as of 2026-09-30 · no account, no network calls
Aisles A–C of the demo warehouse, drawn as stations along the Walk Path.
How a plan runs, start to finish
Every move names its rule and its numbers.
The tool suggests; the planner decides. Nothing changes the import or your company's system.
Fast-moving part into a best location
Slow-moving or dead stock out of a best location
Part moved into its partner's aisle
